data.gender_notes: Sharveshwara is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharveshwara is recorded with the meaning “Lord of the Universe”. Sharveshwara is a Hindu name meaning “Lord of the Universe”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
